objective: Ship This as a Finished Product.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Whole software lifecycle and generated-code provenance
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA is a ground-up software implementation whose source, dependencies, artifacts, defects and recovery must remain attributable.
source_inspections.actual_original_non_applicability_body:
- The work is a read-only inspection or explanatory note with no alteration to software, configuration, dependency, evidence, or lifecycle state.
- An approved engineering baseline covers the exact artifact, version, environment, and change, and impact analysis finds no material effect.
- A prototype is explicitly isolated, non-production, and not represented as verified, secure, supported, or deployable.

The record must state the baseline, scope, owner, evidence date, limitations, and reopening trigger.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Whole software lifecycle and generated-code provenance
Actual authority, privacy, review, lifecycle evidence, recovery and reopening

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Retain exact source/tool/dependency/build identities and generated-code provenance; complete material review, clean builds, integration, hostile-input, compatibility, accessibility and recovery evidence. Test, build, runtime, user acceptance, support and retirement remain separate. No generated code or passing test is owner acceptance.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Computational assumptions, limits and independently challenged claims
source_inspections.decision_reason: The kernel, canonical representations, scheduling, concurrency and graph semantics depend on computational models and resource limits.
source_inspections.actual_original_non_applicability_body: Not applicable to a purely descriptive or bounded editorial change with no computational claim, model, method, requirement, implementation, or evidence consequence. Record the exact scope and reopening trigger.

Actual authority, privacy, review, lifecycle evidence, recovery and reopening

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: State the exact question, definitions, assumptions, correctness and termination/resource properties. Keep proof, conjecture, reference, simulation and actual implementation distinct; retain counterexamples and qualified review. No universal formalism or proof of correctness was invented.
